points.description: Strength(s) and Weakness(es) given as the first two words: S = Strength, W = Weakness.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one of the two is correct.

points.description: Opportunity(ies) and Threat(s) given as the last two words: O = Opportunity, T = Threat.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one of the two is correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for all four words: Strength, Weakness, Opportunity, Threat. Minor spelling errors (e.g. 'Strengh') and singular/plural variants are accepted. Each correct word earns half a mark; wrong or unrelated expansions earn 0 for that word.
